bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a grant to Recovery Cafe Frogtown.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; RECOVERY CAFE FROGTOWN.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Recovery Cafe Frogtown for increased programming and staff to provide support services for individuals impacted by substance use disorders, addiction, mental health challenges, and homelessness. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Recovery Cafe Frogtown for increased programming and staff to provide support services for individuals impacted by substance use disorders, addiction, mental health challenges, and homelessness. This is a onetime appropriation.
